# Chat-Only Package Manifest

## Include

- `platforms/global/chat-only/README.md`
- Common core files from `dist/package-manifest.md`

## Recommended assembled prompt

Use:

1. `core/learning-protocol.{locale}.md`
2. `core/reliability-protocol.{locale}.md`
3. `core/material-grounding-protocol.{locale}.md`
4. `core/state-schema.{locale}.md`
5. `core/output-contract.{locale}.md`

## Acceptance

- Chat-only package works without file read, file write, workflow, or memory.
- It outputs path-labeled Markdown blocks and compact `learning_state`.
